summary: Establish aerobic foundation across all three sports — easy intensity only, build the movement habit

steps.description: Walk to easy jog, Z1 <145 bpm, let legs wake up
Z2 aerobic, 146-162 bpm, conversational pace — slow down if HR exceeds 162
Walk, HR back below 120 bpm, hip flexor and calf stretch

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Active recovery, aerobic flush, legs only

steps.description: Gradual build from 60W toward Z2 low, 90-95 rpm, keep HR below 150
Steady Z2, 106-141W, HR 146-158 bpm, smooth cadence 90-95 rpm, no surges
Easy spin below 90W, HR dropping under 130 bpm

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core Circuit
sessions.notes: 2 rounds (recovery week volume). Circuit: 10x goblet squat 16kg, 10x RDL 16kg dumbbells, 8x/leg TRX split squat, 15x band glute bridge, 8x/side dead bug, 30s plank. 60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds. No shoulder loading. Focus on controlled range of motion.

steps.description: Leg swings forward and lateral (10/leg), hip circles, 10 bodyweight squats, 10 glute bridges
2 rounds: 10x goblet squat 16kg | 10x RDL 16kg | 8x/leg TRX split squat | 15x band glute bridge | 8x/side dead bug | 30s plank. 60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds.
Seated hamstring stretch, figure-4 glute stretch, hip flexor lunge hold — 30-45s each

sessions.name: Long Easy Ride
sessions.focus: Aerobic base volume, sustained Z2 — anchor session of the week

steps.description: Easy rolling warm-up, HR building gradually — no hills, flat terrain for first 15 min
Steady Z2, HR 146-162 bpm throughout — ease off on climbs if HR exceeds 163, flat to rolling route preferred
Easy spin/flat, HR dropping below 140 bpm — stop for 3 min quad and hip flexor stretch before finishing

sessions.focus: 3x10 min at 142-165W (Z3 sweet spot), HR 163-170 bpm

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Progressed
sessions.focus: 3 rounds, increased load (goblet squat 22kg, RDL 22kg), add banded lateral walk

summary: Sharpest week of the block — Z4 threshold cycling, extended Z3 tempo run, full strength circuit
